name: Razorfen Kraul
summary: In the far south of the Barrens, quilboar defend the sacred brambles of Razorfen Kraul. They honor the thickets as the resting place of their ancestor, Agamaggan, while Charlga Razorflank’s rule threatens the region.

sections.title: Blood of the Boar God
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, Agamaggan fought the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients. The colossal wild god fell, but his sacrifice preserved life on Azeroth. Legends tell that thorn-covered vines rose wherever his blood entered the earth, forming thick defenses across the southern plains. The quilboar honor Agamaggan as their divine ancestor and claim the thickets as holy ground. The greatest of them became the Razorfen.

sections.title: The Crone's Ambition
sections.body: Charlga Razorflank rules Razorfen Kraul by despotic force. Under the elder crone, the shamanistic quilboar have set aside their customary skirmishes and now strike rival tribes, regional trade routes, and young Horde settlements together. Whispers and scout reports speak of undead fiends prowling near the brambles. Charlga may be negotiating with Scourge emissaries, hoping forbidden necromancy will strengthen her tribe.

faq.answer: Razorfen Kraul is a vast tangle of thorny vines in the southern Barrens. The quilboar hold it as their spiritual heartland and ancestral home.

faq.q: How were the giant thorns created?
aliases: where did the brambles come from
faq.answer: The enormous brambles rose from the earth ten thousand years ago, during the War of the Ancients, where the fallen boar demigod Agamaggan’s blood spilled.

aliases: who is the boss of rfk
faq.answer: Charlga Razorflank, a ruthless quilboar crone and shaman, rules Razorfen Kraul. She commands the Razorfen tribe and directs attacks on neighboring villages and travelers.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Quilboar attacks threaten young Horde settlements in the Barrens, and scouts have seen undead near the thickets. Their presence raises fears that Charlga is working with the Scourge.

faq.q: Why are Alliance forces interested in the Kraul?
faq.answer: Charlga’s tribe threatens outposts near Feralas and the Thousand Needles. Alliance commanders and scouts at Thalanaar seek her defeat to steady the border.

faq.q: What does defeating Earthcaller Halmgar mean for the story?
aliases: what happens after earthcaller halmgar dies
faq.answer: Earthcaller Halmgar is a rare and influential geomancer deep in the thickets. Defeating him weakens the quilboar’s earth-shaping priesthood, disrupts Charlga Razorflank’s defenses, and hinders their power to shape Agamaggan’s sacred brambles.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the quilboar have long contested Mulgore’s borders. Their dark alliances and harm to the earth make Razorfen Kraul a matter of tribal defense.
As a shaman, you see how quilboar geomancy twists the earth and elements around Agamaggan’s blood, turning primal powers to savage ends.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect supply wagons and young settlements across the southern Barrens by curbing Razorfen Kraul’s aggression.
As an undead, you may take interest in strange reagents, bat guano, and reports of Scourge incursions among the briars.
